svg.text: Voice tail and the agents' goodput: weka-x32-long, 2 callers, 1 warm-up turn
seconds, median of the runs • Lower is better
tokens/s over the calls • Higher is better
The darker blue bar is the configuration to deploy.
A bar cut square runs past the scale's end; its value says how far.
The SLO is the p95 of voice alone with as many callers, plus 250 ms.
